items.information: Opawa Open 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: [FR] En accord avec la politique de santé publique et les directives de l'ÉTS, tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront porter un masque à l'intérieur des bâtiments. Le port du couvre-visage en tissu est interdit. Dans l'éventualité où les directives changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel. Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet Santé & Sécurité. **Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, vous devez réserver votre place sur le [portail de réservation](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) dans monÉTS dans la section "Activités de la vie étudiante". Vous devez enregistrer au plus tard le vendredi 15 avril à 15h. Une fois que c'est fait j'aurais la liste des étudiants qui n'auront pas besoin de payer. Vous devez donc ensuite vous inscrire sur le site web WCA en même temps que tout le monde, simplement vous n'aurez pas à payer les frais d'inscription. Je précise que vous devez enregister le plus tôt possible, car être enregistré sur le portail de réservation ne vous garantie pas une place dans la compétition. Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement en cas d'annulation** (à cause des frais de transaction). Cependant si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée. [EN] As per the current public health policy and the directives of the university, all competitors and their guest must wear a mask at all time inside the buildings. Wearing a cloth mask is prohibited. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the regulations change. Take clear note especially of the Health and Safety Tab. **ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, you must reserve your place on the [reservation portal](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) on monÉTS in the "Activités de la vie étudiante" section. You must register there by Friday, April 15 at 15h. Once you register there I will have the list of students who do not need to pay. You can then register on the WCA site without paying the fee. You should register as quickly as possible, as being registered on the monÉTS portal does not guarantee you a place in the competition. There will be **no refunds in case of cancellation** (due to transaction fees) . However, if you register and you are not able to come, please let us know so we can give the spot to someone else. You will still be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the the registration period closes.

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Navojoa, Sonora mejor conocida como La Perla del Mayo, es una bonita ciudad ubicada en el Sur de Sonora, rodeada de Sierra, Mar y Desierto. La tribu Mayo habita el sur de Sonora desde hace cientos de años, entre sus tradiciones mas destacadas podemos mencionar la danza del venado que es conocida a nivel internacional. La competencia del **Open del Mayo 2019** se desarrollara en el **CAS del Instituto Tecnologico de Sonora** principal universidad de la region, que cuenta con comodas instalaciones que permitiran a los participantes dar sus mejores tiempos. A menos de una hora de Navojoa se encuentra la playa de Huatabampito, El pueblo magico de Alamos y una gran variedad de atracciones turisticas de tipo rural. **INGLES** Navojoa, Sonora better known as the Pearl of May, is a beautiful city located in the South of Sonora, surrounded by Sierra, Sea and Desert. The Mayo tribe inhabits southern Sonora for hundreds of years, among its most outstanding traditions we can mention the deer dance that is known internationally. The competition del **Open del Mayo 2019** will be held at the **CAS of the Instituto Tecnologico de Sonora**, the main university in the region, which has comfortable facilities that will allow participants to give their best times. Less than an hour from Navojoa is the beach of Huatabampito, the magical town of Alamos and a wide variety of tourist attractions of a rural type. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbEVCIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--002a6631cf7fd8fb5b95574a60b59d2f48be6794/Display%20rubik%20del%20mayo.jpg2.jpg)

items.name: Örebro Minxfest 2024
items.information: Välkomna till en tävling i Örebro med ett fokus på sidogrenar! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Tre försök av FMC kommer att hållas under morgonen fram till lunch, så om du inte deltar i FMC behöver du inte komma till lokalen förrens lunch. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to a competition in Örebro with a focus on side events! Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. Three attempts of FMC will be held during the morning up until lunch, so you don't have to come to the venue before lunch if you're not participating in FMC. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: Välkomna till den andra upplagan av Örebro Open! Detta blir Sveriges andra tävling med Dual Rounds, vilket innebär att alla tävlande i 3x3, OH och 2x2 har möjligheten att få tävla i minst två rundor. Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to the 2nd edition of Örebro Open! This will be Sweden's second competition with Dual Rounds, which means that all competitors in 3x3, OH and 2x2 are allowed to compete in at least two rounds. Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Däremot är platserna begränsade till sju deltagare, så anmäl dig snarast om du är sugen! items.information: (HR) Osijek Open 2020 je četrnaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom. Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Članovi Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska ostvaruju 25% popusta na kotizaciju. -------------- (EN) Osijek Open 2020 is the 14th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia have 25% discount on the registration fee.

items.information: (HR) **Ukoliko nemate važeću EU COVID potvrdu, ne možete pristupiti prostorima natjecanja zbog pravila stožera civilne zaštite Republike Hrvatske o javnim okupljanjima. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.

items.information: Oskemen Open 2023 - это открытый чемпионат в городе Усть-Каменогорск. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3500 тенге. Базовый регистрационный взнос за одну дисциплину составляет 1000 тенге. Бұл жарысты QBERS командасы мен С.Аманжолов атындағы Шығыс Қазақстан университеті ұйымдастырып отыр. **English** Oskemen Open 2023 is a competition in the city of Oskemen. The base registration fee for a single event is 1000 tenge. The registration fee is 3500 tenge for additional events. These competitions are organized by the QBERS team and Amanzholov University.

items.name: Oslo Open 2022
items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2022! Dette er den første kube konkuransen i Oslo siden 2015! Vi gleder oss! Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Påmeldingen åpner lørdag 28. mai kl 16:00 norsk tid. Det koster 150 NOK å delta. Prisen inkluderer et måltid med mat og drikke på lørdag. Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take away tilbud i nærområdet. Vi følger lokale koronarestriksjoner. Pr dd er det ingen særlige krav eller restriksjoner i Oslo. ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015! You can register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The registration opens Saturday 28 of May at 6:00 PM Norwegian time. We follow local Covid restrictions. As of today, there are no special requirements or restrictions in Oslo.

items.name: Oslo Open 2024
items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2024! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

items.information: Otago October 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the Rubik's Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.name: Ottawa 3x3x3 Fall A 2024
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [EN] ### OCDSB Students! OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: "OCDSB Student, my student email is {student email here}" Please do not pay the registration fee. ### Ottawa Fall Series This competition is in a series with Ottawa 3x3x3 Fall B 2024 (Saturday Morning) and Ottawa 3x3x3 Fall C 2024 (Saturday Afternoon). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ### Registration Reminders If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. --- [FR] ### Les élèves de l'OCDSB! Les élèves de l'OCDSB (élèves du primaire et du secondaire) participent gratuitement aux compétitions! Veuillez ajouter la note suivante dans les commentaires de votre inscription: "Étudiant de l'OCDSB, mon email d'étudiant est {email d'étudiant ici}". Ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. ### Série d'automne d'Ottawa Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Ottawa 3x3x3 Fall B 2024 (samedi matin) et Ottawa 3x3x3 Fall C 2024 (samedi après-midi). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Si vous n'êtes pas un étudiant de l'OCDSB, vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Si vous n'êtes pas un étudiant de l'OCDSB, vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LH3QG7krdgc). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc). ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Ottawa Blindfolded 2025
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [EN] ### Please be Quiet All of the events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. ### Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Registration Reminders **Registration will close on Friday September 19th 2025 at 10 pm (8 days before the competition)**. You must register and pay the registration fee before this date in order for your registration to be accepted. Late registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. If you have any questions, please contact us using the *Contact Organization team* link at the top of this page. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video explains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Silence s'il vous plaît Toutes les épreuves de cette compétition sont des épreuves ***avec les yeux bandés***, qui nécessitent une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer. ### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent résoudre des casse-tête les yeux bandés (voir le règlement [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription **Les inscriptions seront clôturées le vendredi 19 septembre 2025 à 22h (8 jours avant la compétition)**. Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant cette date pour que votre inscription soit acceptée. Les inscriptions en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. Si vous avez des questions, veuillez nous contacter en utilisant le lien *Contact Équipe organisatrice* en haut de cette page. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [Les bases d'une compétition officielle de la WCA](https://youtu.be/LH3QG7krdgc?feature=shared). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [À quoi s'attendre pour votre première compétition](https://youtu.be/yYZHzTc0GMc?feature=shared). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.name: Please Be Quiet Pickering Winter 2024
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This isn't your typical speed solving competition as ***3x3x3 Fewest Moves (FMC)*** and ***Blindfolded events*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration, and FMC is an exam-style event in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and writing it down on paper. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to compete in FMC or solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Please Be Solved Pickering 2022
items.information: ### Blindfolded events only The only events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. ### FMC Canada connection This competition will be held during the morning/early afternoon on the same day as [FMC Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2022) in the same venue as the Pickering, ON location. You are welcome to register for one or both competitions, but please note that you would need to ***register for FMC Canada separately***. ### Note for new competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. ## Other competitions [FMC Canada 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2023) (Pickering location) and [Please Be Solved Pickering 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PleaseBeSolvedPickering2023) will take place at the same venue, earlier in the day _before_ this competition. Each competition will end before the next competition begins, ensuring no overlap. Please feel free to register for one or multiple competitions, but **you must register for each competition separately**. ### Note for new competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com o delegado (gcampos@worldcubeassociation.org)**. Pagamento da taxa via PIX: mauriciopmfernandes@gmail.com Enviar comprovante para o e-mail: gcampos@worldcubeassociation.org Envie o comprovante com o nome do competidor. **Aviso**: Ao se inscrever para a competição, você automaticamente se disponibiliza para atuar como juiz, runner e/ou embaralhador quando solicitado. items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTc4NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--01c41a8280fe19ef88356bbc5b97d7c710f9edd2/Club%20de%20Speedcubing%20de%20l%E2%80%99Universit%C3%A9%20Laval.png)](https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61575052693279) ### (FR) ### Silence s'il vous plaît L'épreuve principale de cette compétition est la résolution optimisée, qui nécessite une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer. ### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent faire le défi des moindres mouvements (3x3 Résolution optimisée), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas. ### Liste de diffusion Nous travaillons fort pour répondre à la demande de compétitions au Québec et nous planifions et annonçons régulièrement de nouvelles compétitions. Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou (https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ### Club de speedcubing de l'Université Laval Les membres du Club de Speedcubing de l'Université Laval peuvent s'inscrire sans frais. Si vous êtes membre, inscrivez votre IDUL dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. --- ### (EN) ### Please be quiet The main event in this competition is the Fewest Moves Challenge, which requires a great deal of learning, practice and concentration. All those present, including participants and guests, are asked to make no noise to enable the participants to concentrate. ### Note for new competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to participate in the Fewest Moves Challenge, this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in Quebec and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### Speedcubing Club of Université Laval Members of the Laval University Speedcubing Club may register for free by writing their IDUL in the registration comments

items.information: Witajcie zawodnicy na zawodach z cyklu Polish Sylwester Tour 2025! Ta edycja odbędzie się w Poznaniu. Macie okazję na ułożenie swoich trzech ostatnich prób FMa w roku 2025! **Pamiętajcie, że na tych zawodach nie odbywa się standardowe układanie kostki Rubika na czas. items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg2MDQ4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f2b0d908f18e079874aebc1d845f74b2731566c4/cactusini%20cubini%20chico%20chico.png)](https://www.instagram.com/asa_speedcubing/) --- Bienvenidos a "Pacha Cubing: Jujuy 2026". El nombre del torneo rinde homenaje a la Pachamama, la Madre Tierra en la cosmovisión andina. Durante todo el mes de agosto, nuestra región lleva a cabo un rito ancestral para agradecer a la tierra por sus frutos mediante ofrendas tradicionales, como alimentos, bebidas y hojas de coca. **POR FAVOR LEER LA PESTAÑA ["IMPORTANTE"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PachaCubingJujuy2026#75268-importante-important) PARA REALIZAR EL REGISTRO CORRECTAMENTE** --- Welcome to "Pacha Cubing: Jujuy 2026". The tournament's name pays tribute to the Pachamama, the Mother Earth in the Andean worldview. Throughout August, our region holds an ancestral ritual to thank the earth for its harvest through traditional offerings, such as food, beverages, and coca leaves. **PLEASE READ THE ["IMPORTANT"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PachaCubingJujuy2026#75268-importante-important) TAB IN ORDER TO REGISTER SUCCESSFULLY**

items.information: **ESPAÑOL** Nuevamente el Palacio de la Juventud y la Municipalidad de Los Olivos nos brindarán su apoyo para llevar a cabo este torneo de speedsolving. Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la [pestaña “Horario" (Schedule)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la [pestaña “Categorías” (Events)](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. **ENGLISH** Once again Palacio de la Juventud and Municipalidad de Los Olivos are supporting another speedsolving competition. The results of this competition will be listed on the WCA world rankings and new competitors will get an official WCA profile. For that reason, each competitor must be familiar with and understand the WCA Regulations before the competition. Each competitor must carefully choose the events in which he/she will participate after having seen the [Schedule tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-schedule). Please pay attention to the formats of each round and its respective time limits and cutoffs detailed at the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PalaciodelCubo2019#competition-events). It is important to carefully write your name, birth date, and other information properly. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted. If this is your second competition, you must have already claimed your WCA ID.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTEyMTMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--020d70e1b7886d8b3a0c8e7ce19290d550df6012/2025_logo.png) # Português Esta competição está participando do Mês Oficial do Novato da WCA 2025. O processo de inscrição reservará 50% das vagas para novatos. Novatos são considerados como não tendo ID da WCA ou um ID da WCA com 2025. Os competidores veteranos são considerados como tendo um ID da WCA de 2024 ou anterior. Todos os competidores ainda devem seguir todos os requisitos de inscrição para que sua inscrição seja considerada completa. As inscrições serão aceitas com base nos seguintes critérios: * 50% das vagas (30 vagas) são inicialmente reservadas para competidores novatos. * 50% das vagas (30 vagas) estarão disponíveis para competidores veteranos, por ordem de chegada. * Se mais de 30 competidores novatos se inscreverem antes que 60 vagas sejam preenchidas por competidores veteranos, quaisquer novatos adicionais serão aceitos por ordem de chegada, juntamente com os competidores veteranos. * Se as 30 vagas reservadas para novatos não forem preenchidas por novatos duas semanas antes da competição (até dia 2 de Março de 2025), as vagas restantes, até o limite de competidores, serão aceitas de competidores veteranos. Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar. Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com o delegado ([bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org)). 50% da taxa de inscrição será reembolsada se o competidor desistir até 9 de março de 2025. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento. Por favor leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. # English This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50% of spots (30 spots) are initially reserved for new competitors. * 50% of spots (30 spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If more than 30 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the 30 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition (until March 2nd 2025), remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the delegate ([bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org)). 50% of the register fee will be refunded if the competitor withdraw up until March 9 2025. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: **Português** Será um prazer recebê-los e temos algumas dicas para vocês, competidores e acompanhantes: - Chegue ao local da competição 20 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! - Inscrições no dia do campeonato estarão abertas somente para 3x3x3. **English** It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition 20 minutes before the modality that you will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubers. - Try to have a lot of fun! - Entries on the day of the competition will only be open for 3x3x3.

items.information: Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. - Será permitido, devido ao espaço do evento, no máximo dois acompanhantes por competidor, com uma taxa de R$ 5,00, por cada acompanhante a ser paga junto com a inscrição. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! Tips: - Arrive at the competition location at least 30 minutes before the category you will participate in; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. - Due to the event space, a maximum of two companions per competitor, with a fee of R$5.00 for each companion to be paid together with registration. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg4MDkyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--92b7630e165872195532ef2875376f220d23d0c0/Paridades%20y%20Puntas%20Caracas%202026.png) ## ![Español](https://i.ibb.co/R9FXtCV/spanish-flag.png) Español ## Bienvenido a Paridades y Puntas Caracas 2026 **Por favor leer todas las pestañas antes de registrarte, hay mucha información importante que debes saber, incluso si eres un competidor recurrente.** * Límite de **40** competidores para el registro. * Es una competencia abierta, para competidores de cualquier edad y experiencia. * **Nuevos Competidores:** hemos creado una [pestaña exclusiva](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ParidadesyPuntasCaracas2026#76010-nuevos-competidores-newcomers) para ustedes. Estas imágenes podrán ser utilizadas para la promoción futura de competencias, redes sociales y sitio web oficial, transmisiones en vivo, así como para material documental y archivo histórico. Si no deseas aparecer en ninguna grabación, por favor notifícalo al equipo organizador al momento de tu registro o durante el evento. Tu participación implica la aceptación de este aviso. ## ![English](https://i.ibb.co/HT0yLMw/english-flag.png) English ## Welcome to Paridades y Puntas Caracas 2026 **Please read all the tabs before registering; there is a lot of important information you should know, even if you are a recurring competitor.** * Competitor registration limit: **40**. * It is an open competition, for competitors of any age and experience. * **New Competitors:** we have created an [exclusive tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ParidadesyPuntasCaracas2026#76011-) for you. It is very important to read it. * If you have any questions, contact the organizing team. #### 📸 Filming Notice By attending **Paridades y Puntas Caracas 2026**, you authorize the organization to take photographs and record videos during the event. These images may be used for future competition promotion, social media and official website, live streaming, as well as for documentary and historical archive material. If you do not wish to appear in any recording, please notify the organizing team at the time of registration or during the event. Your participation implies acceptance of this notice. ## **Información de Contacto / Contact Info:** • Enrymar Cisneros Teléfono: 0426-5335576 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584265335576&text=%C2%A1Hola%20Enrymar!%20Quiero%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Paridades%20y%20Puntas%20Caracas%202026*) speedcubingvenezuela@gmail.com • Patricia Barrios Teléfono: 0412-5975095 [WhatsApp](https://api.whatsapp.com/send?phone=+584125975095&text=%C2%A1Hola%20Patricia!%20Quiero%20m%C3%A1s%20informaci%C3%B3n%20de%20la%20competencia%20*Paridades%20y%20Puntas%20Caracas%202026*) speedcubingcaracas@gmail.com

items.information: Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Ao se inscrever você se compromete a ajudar como juiz, corredor ou qualquer função solicitada por um delegado da competição; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. - Ao se inscrever você está autorizando o uso de imagem para divulgações sobre o campeonato. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! Tips: - Arrive at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the event you will be participating in; - The cube you will be competing with must be in good condition; - By registering, you agree to assist as a judge, runner, or in any other role requested by a delegate; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, so take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of magic cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organizing team and delegates. - By registering, you are authorizing the use of your image for publicity about the competition. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we always have room for new cubers. Have fun!

Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet [Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Pasde3x3aGatineau2024#36319-sante-securite-health-safety). If you register and you are not able to come, please let us know so we can give the spot to someone else. You will still be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the the registration period closes. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: 🇧🇷 **Português** ** Bem-vindos à primeira competição de Cubo Mágico do Planalto Médio do Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Localizada no norte do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, na região conhecida como Planalto Médio, a cidade de Passo Fundo destaca-se pela representatividade nas áreas médica, cultural, educacional, agrícola de precisão e tecnológica. Por estar localizada numa região estratégica do Rio Grande do Sul e próxima do centro e oeste de Santa Catarina, o Passo Fundo Cubing 2025 promete a inserção do Cubo Mágico em um espaço pouco alcançado até o momento, trazendo a promessa de crescimento do esporte numa verdadeira expansão para os atletas que buscam as possibilidades de participação nos campeonatos oficiais. Agora chegou a vez de Passo Fundo alcançar a representatividade também no Esporte para o Cérebro! Divulgar esse esporte em nível oficial, e levar aos competidores a oportunidade de participação, é o objetivo solidário da organização e dos apoiadores, especialmente da Secretaria Municipal de Educação e da Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, que apoiam o evento! Nos vemos lá! 🇬🇧 **English:** ** Welcome to the first speedcubing competition in Passo Fundo - Rio Grande do Sul !!!! ** Located in the north of the state of Rio Grande do Sul, in the region known as "middle plateau", the city of Passo Fundo stands out due to its representation in medical, cultural, educational, precision farming and technology areas. Since it is located in a strategical region in Rio Grande do Sul and close to the center and West of the state of Santa Catarina, this competition is a certain path to introducing speedcubing somewhere not fully reached yet, with the promise of growth to the sport, bringing a chace of participating in official competitions. Now it is Passo Fundo's turn to reach its representation in the mind sport too! Spreading this sport officially and taking the opportunity to the competitors are the objectives of the organisers and supporters, especially of Secretaria Municipal de Educação and of Prefeitura Municipal de Passo Fundo, who support the event! We will meet there!

items.information: ##### 🇧🇷 O **Pé Vermelho 2023** é um campeonato **aberto** e **beneficente**. Aqui estão algumas instruções e lembretes para quem pretende participar: * Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register). * As inscrições vão até o dia **20/10/2023**, ou até que o **limite de 50 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes. * Chegue ao local da competição, com seu cubo em mãos, no mínimo 30 minutos antes do horário de qualquer modalidade que você participará. * É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. * O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição. * Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. * Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento! * Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande seus questionamentos para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores! * Divirta-se! --- ##### 🇺🇸 **Pé Vermelho 2023** is an **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate: * All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelho2023/register) tab. * Registration closes on **10/20/2023**, or whenever the **limit of 50 competitors** is reached. items.information: # This competition has been cancelled. # The date for this competition has changed to August 20-21, 2021. Please familiarize yourself with the [Safety Plan] (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vgSyWUwrL1MkixikzJqiZXodSBejV2S39T_18PCm5-E/edit). 1. If COVID-19 cases drop to below 10 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will continue as announced. 2. If COVID-19 cases are between 10 and 20 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will continue, but all attendees (spectators and competitors) must show either proof of full vaccination (2 weeks since last shot of 1 or 2 dose series) or have a negative COVID-19 test within 96 hours of the beginning of the event, or after 8:00am Eastern on Monday, August 16th, 2021. There are no exceptions. 3. If COVID-19 cases are greater than 20 cases / 100,000 residents within two weeks of the competition, the competition will not continue and we will either reschedule or cancel at that time. # Maximum one spectator per competitor. ## This competition’s registration and waitlist is full. We are very excited to announce the inaugural Pennsylvania Championship! Join us for a very sweet weekend of cubing and fun in historic Hershey Pennsylvania. We will have two special unofficial events as well as the option to have a day at HersheyPark on Sunday with all of your friends. This is the state championship for Pennsylvania, however, anyone can attend. All state champion titles are unofficial and are **not** recognized by the World Cube Association or CubingUSA. For more information on state champion eligibility, see the [PA Title eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PennsylvaniaChampionship2021#14358-pa-title-eligibility). This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations Live results can be found on our WCA Live page, which will be available during the competition. Before registering, you must read the "Competitor Information" tab. This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition. Day 1 Events: Pyraminx, Clock, Megaminx, 3x3 Blindfolded, 6x6, 7x7, Sq-1, FMC Day 2 Events: 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 3x3 One Handed **This competition is sponsored by TheCubicle!** Visit the [Sponsor/Vending](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PennsylvaniaChampionship2021#14359-sponsor-vending) tab for more information.

items.name: Peristeri Spring Open 2025
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6ODAxNDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--3bff12c8b9b6016985d4932977574e412605ceb3/486747483_24056017737321961_6930283358538797018_n.jpg) Το Peristeri Spring Open 2025 θα είναι o τρίτος επίσημος διαγωνισμός της Ελλάδας για το 2025 και ο πρώτος που γίνεται ποτέ στον Δήμο Περιστερίου! Στην συνεδριακή αίθουσα του ΚΥΒΕ Περιστερίου για 2 μέρες παλιοί και νέοι, μικροί και μεγάλοι Cubers απ´ όλη τη χώρα και όχι μόνο θα συναντηθούμε ξανά για το αγαπημένο μας χόμπυ. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε σε μια ακόμα γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε έτοιμοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Peristeri Spring Open 2025 will be Greece’s third official competition of 2025 and the first ever to be held in the Municipality of Peristeri! For two days, in the conference hall of KYVE Peristeriou, cubers from all over the country and beyond—young and old, new and experienced—will come together once again for our favorite hobby. Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and join us for another cubing celebration! Please read the following tabs very carefully! Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTg3NzY2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--baad0ffa68c853ed34e6b5f7772b1d3f681c2028/IMG_0509.png) ### Welcome to Philippine Championship 2026! The **Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee** (NSOC) proudly presents the 15th World Cube Association National Championship for the **Philippines**, the annual culmination of the best Filipino speedcubers in their respective events. This competition brings together the nation's top talents for an exciting showcase of skill, determination, and sportsmanship. Only the **top three** winners representing the **Philippines** of each category will receive physical awards such as medals and plaques. The top three winners of any Finals, regardless of nationality, will be recognized together with the top three at the awarding ceremony. Looking for 3x3 Fewest Moves? Check out [Philippine FMC Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineFMCChampionship2026). ###### *Page unavailable? The competition hasn't been announced yet. Please stay updated and be ready for any adjustments. We also recommend arriving at least 30 minutes before your event to avoid missing it. ###### *By participating in this event, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge that the organizing bodies, their staff, and affiliated individuals will not be liable, to the fullest extent permitted by law, for any injuries, loss of personal belongings, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition. Furthermore, by your presence, you may be photographed and recorded for media to be used in any format for any purpose worldwide by the organization team and its partners. This includes your likeness and voice to be included therein without compensation, credit, or other consideration. If you do not wish to be photographed, recorded, or appear under these conditions, you should not participate and enter the event premises.*

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTczODc3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--02e6d29a61b0dd2745ee55791e80dd6dccf8b9cd/image.png) ### **Welcome to the first ever Philippine FMC Championship.** This competition will determine the **2026 Philippine National Champion** for **3x3 Fewest Moves**. This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look at [Philippine Championship 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineChampionship2026). --- ### Locations See [Location tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PhilippineFMCChampionship2026#73905-locations) for more details. --- *Additional locations may be added until 14 days before the competition starts, so stay tuned for updates!*

items.information: ## Pickering 2023 Series We are running four competitions as part of the Pickering 2023 Series. You will only be able to compete in *one* of these four competitions. Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ## Registration Reminder You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. items.name: Pickering Blindfolded 2026
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Blindfolded Events Only The only events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. ## FMC Canada 2026 [FMC Canada 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2026) (Pickering location) will take place at the same venue. If you are registering for both competitions, **you must register for each competition separately**. ### Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Pickering Side Events 2023
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Pickering Side Events 2023 Cubing on the Canada Day long weekend! As we celebrate our country and communities, Canada Day is also an important opportunity to reflect on the historical and ongoing colonization and erasure of Indigenous Peoples on the lands we now call Canada. This competition will be held on the Treaty and traditional territory of the Mississaugas of Scugog Island First Nation and Williams Treaties signatories of the Mississauga and Chippewa Nations. All proceeds from this competition will be donated to the [Indian Residential School Survivors Society](https://www.irsss.ca) and [Woodland Cultural Centre](https://woodlandculturalcentre.ca). ## Side Events This competition has "side events", which does _not_ include the standard 3x3x3 Cube event. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada&show_registration_status=on) if this competition is not suitable for you. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Mailing List We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand for competitions in southern Ontario and are regularly planning and announcing more competitions. items.information: ### ¡Bienvenidos al Pitic Open 2020! **Les damos una *cálida* bienvenida desde la ciudad de *Hermosillo, Sonora*, también conocida como la *Ciudad del Sol*, ¡icónica por sus atardeceres anaranjados y deliciosa comida!** Hermosillo, anteriormente conocida como *La Villa del Pitic*, es la ciudad capital y más poblada del estado de Sonora, México. Esta ciudad cuenta con un sinfin de lugares turísticos y cerca se encuentra la playa de Bahía de Kino; una de las playas más bellas y seguras de Sonora e incluso de México, donde el mar y el desierto se mezclan. ¡¡¡Esperamos tu asistencia y bienvenido a Sonora, tu casa!!! ### Welcome to Pitic Open 2020 ! **We give you a *warm* welcome from the city of *Hermosillo, Sonora*, also it is known as the *City of the Sun*, iconic for its orange sunsets and delicious food!** Hermosillo, formerly known as *La Villa del Pitic*, is the capital and most populous city in the state of Sonora, Mexico. This city has a myriad of tourist places and also nearby is the beach of Bahia de Kino, one of the most beautiful and safest beaches in Sonora and even in Mexico, where the sea and the desert mix. We look forward to your assistance to the competition and welcome to Sonora your home!!! ![Pitic rubiks competition](https://scontent.fmex1-1.fna.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/p960x960/80538161_102466167938751_4388140482568388608_o.png?_nc_cat=111&_nc_ohc=ETI8PryJytsAQl0yt8OPfOHSizlR8Yw0ZIasCZuLeIFLRs9OyFrDf2xmg&_nc_ht=scontent.fmex1-1.fna&oh=0b48717925b486c7d873579ea3030236&oe=5EAD96B3)

No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue. # All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: ##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Sunday, July 31st is insufficient for entrance to the competition. ##### **OR** ##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Wednesday, August 10th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. #### ##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. #####

items.name: Please Be Clocked Cape Town 2024
items.information: ## Information [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Please Be Clocked Cape Town 2024! This competition has a full array of blindfolded events, with Clock and 5x5 to mix things up. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, and make payment by buying a ticket. Please see payment details below. **Important** - if we do not have enough competitors to hold 3x3 Blindfolded Round 2, we will adjust the schedule to have 2 Rounds of 5x5 instead. **PLEASE NOTE** This competition does NOT have 3x3 or other popular events like 2x2 or Pyraminx. If you are a newcomer, please do not register unless you are able to solve cubes Blindfolded or would like to participate in the 5x5 or Clock events. ## SPECTATORS Spectators are only allowed as companions to competitors. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with **volunteering** during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". If any competitor or competitor's guests are willing to help judge with the blindfolded events, especially Multiple Blindfolded, please let us know. If you are able to assist with judging the longer events (4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and Multiple Blindfolded), we will reward you with a free coffee, chocolate, or other small gift :) #### About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you are able to assist in any way and want to get involved, please get in touch [here](https://cubingza.org/contact)!

items.name: Please Be Quiet Joburg 2023
items.information: ### This is not a normal competition We won't be holding any normal events. This competition is focused on blindfolded events, with a single fewest move attempt to keep things interesting. If you have not competed before, this may not be the best experience for your first competition. Sign up at [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) to get notifications for other competitions in your province. **Please be quiet**. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund. ### Venue The venue is in a private venue in Bryanston. Access for all competitors and guests need to be arranged in advance. Failure to do so will result in you or your guests being denied access to the venue. There is limited parking that needs to be arranged in advance. **All competitors** must please provide the following information: 1. If you will be arriving by car, please provide registration number. 2. If you will be getting a lift with someone, please provide the name of the person you will be getting a lift with. 3. If using an Uber or other transport, please indicate this. Once you have provided this information, you will be given the exact address. ### Guests Competitors may bring only one guest due to venue constraints. If a competitor is bringing a guest, then they must provide the full name and surname. ### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This is not a typical speed solving competition, as ***blindfolded events*** and ***Fewest Moves*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. Fewest Moves is an exam-style event in which competitors spend up to one hour finding the shortest solution they can and writing it down on paper. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded and/or how to write out solutions on paper (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Please feel free to register for one or multiple competitions, but **you must register for each competition separately**. ### Note for new competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. items.name: Please Be Solved This Time Joburg 2023
items.information: ## This is not a normal competition We won't be holding any normal events. This competition is entirely focused on blindfolded events,. If you have not competed before, this may not be the best experience for your first competition. Sign up at [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) to get notifications for other competitions in your province. **Please be quiet**. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund. ## Venue The venue is in a private venue in Bryanston. Access for all competitors and guests need to be arranged in advance. Failure to do so will result in you or your guests being denied access to the venue. There is limited parking that needs to be arranged in advance. **All competitors** must please provide the following information in the comments of their registration: 1. If you will be arriving by car, please provide registration number. 2. If you will be getting a lift with someone, please provide the name of the person you will be getting a lift with. 3. If using an Uber or other transport, please indicate this. Once you have provided this information, you will be given the exact address. ## Guests Competitors may bring only one guest due to venue constraints. If a competitor is bringing a guest, then they must provide the full name and surname. ## About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

venue.name: Academia Bergues Esportes
venue.address: Rua Brás da Silva 124, Tigre, Poções, Bahia

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: ![Image description](https://i.imgur.com/YSp2SyW.png) ## **FFP2 MASKS ARE MANDATORY** This is a quiet events competition. items.name: Polish Championship 2022
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdnNZIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5dab4db532469b133dcb4913ae4f07994fbe1f39/LOGO_MP22_pro.png) Mistrzostwa Polski w Speedcubingu to najważniejsza impreza sezonu w kalendarzu każdego polskiego speedcubera. Od 2005 roku nieprzerwanie przyciąga najlepszych zawodników, którzy w atmosferze ducha fair play walczą o tytuł mistrza kraju we wszystkich oficjalnych konkurencjach World Cube Association. Po niezwykle udanej edycji 2021 Mistrzostwa Polski ponownie zostaną przeprowadzone w miejscu wyjątkowym jakim jest Olivia Star! Poraz kolejny rywalizacji na najwyższym poziomie będą towarzyszyły niesamowite widoki 34 piętra Olivia Star - największego wieżowca w północnej Polsce! --- Polish Speedcubing Championship is the most important event of the year of every Polish speedcuber. Since 2005 it continues to attract best competitors who compete for national titles in all events sanctioned by World Cube Association. After successful 2021 edition this year's championship will be held in a special place - Olivia Star! Once again competing at the highest level will be accompanied by amazing views from 34th floor of Olivia Star building - highest scyscraper in northern Poland!
